title: The Grammatical Depths Where Numbers Flow

features.name: numbers that speak in currents
features.desc-on-touch: Here the left channel became mathematics. Every number flows like water. Every word carries a quantity of meaning.

features.name: the language that divides in half
features.desc-on-touch: Words and numbers poured from one source. They learned to flow in different channels. This is the deeper channel, where every syllable holds a sum.

features.name: the pool where mathematics remembers speech
features.desc-on-touch: The depths hold equations that dream in voices. Numbers learned that they could tell stories if they flowed long enough.

features.name: the counting deep
features.desc-on-touch: Every word here has been counted. Every number here has been spoken. In these depths they learned to be the same thing.

features.name: the syntax that flows
features.desc-on-touch: Grammar learned to move like water. Conjugation is current. The structure of meaning is the structure of flow.

inscription: in the left channel the numbers learned to speak in grammatical currents; they will never meet the words again but they remember the union
